ai_summary.title: Lv 25

ai_summary.title: Lv 37

Grand Attack on the whole party as it falls.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Flame Thrower 3 in 4, Dragon Fang 1 in 4, on a random member.

name: Guard Scorpion
notes: Search Scope only marks the next target and does no damage. When it raises its tail, stop attacking: any hit while the tail is up triggers Tail Laser on the whole party. Defend or heal until the tail lowers, then go back to Bolt and attacks.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (8-turn cycle)
rows: Search Scope marks a random member (“Locked On Target”); it does no damage.
Attacks the marked member: Scorpion Tail 1 in 3, and always below half HP; otherwise Rifle.
Raises its tail, raising its Defense and Magic Defense. The first time, Barret says to attack while the tail is up: don't.
Lowers its tail; the cycle starts over.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Any action against it: Tail Laser on the whole party.

name: Air Buster
notes: Hits to its back deal far more damage, and each one draws a counter: usually it turns and uses Bodyblow on the attacker, otherwise it fires Rear Gun. On its own turns it faces the member it targets, so alternate attackers to keep reaching its back. Fires Big Bomber at one member up to 4 times, then switches to Energy Ball and Rear Gun. Below 20% HP it can no longer turn.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Big Bomber on a random member, turning to face them first when needed (“Program 1 Operation”). After the 4th: “Big Bomber's out of ammo.”
On a random member: Energy Ball at one in front of it, Rear Gun at one behind it (“Program 2 Operation”).

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Counters the attacker: 2 in 3 it turns around and uses Bodyblow, otherwise Rear Gun. Hits from the front draw no counter.
“Turn Function non-operational”: it can no longer turn, so counters are always Rear Gun, and a Big Bomber turn aimed at a member behind it is lost.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: An ally KO'd or below half HP, or Scotch hit
Machine Gun on a random member.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Picks one member at the start and keeps attacking them (a random member once they are KO'd). The last member to hit Scotch becomes its new target.
Scotch hit, or a Lackey KO'd

name: Aps
notes: Opens with Sewer Tsunami on the party. Any spell makes it use Sewer Tsunami twice over its next turns, and so does dropping below 1/3 HP (once). Otherwise it uses Tail Attack or Lick, which inflicts Sadness and slows Limit gauges. Cross-slash can paralyze it, and a paralyzed Aps cannot counter.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Sewer Tsunami on everyone in the battle, itself included.
1 in 4: Lick (Sadness) on the second party member (a random one if they are KO'd). Otherwise Tail Attack on a random member, preferring the back row.
Its next 4 turns: nothing, Sewer Tsunami, nothing, Sewer Tsunami; then back to normal.

name: Turks:reno
notes: Pyramid traps an ally, who then counts as KO'd; if everyone is trapped the battle is lost. Free them by attacking the Pyramid with another character. In his first three fights, a Bolt spell on him makes his next turn an attack on the caster (Electro-mag Rod, which can paralyze, in the first; Electroprod and Electroprod 2 in the next two). When fought with other Turks, the battle ends as soon as one Turk falls.

ai_summary.title: First fight (Lv 17)
rows: Pyramid on a random member who is not KO'd or trapped (“Try and break it if you can.”). The trapped member counts as KO'd until another member destroys the Pyramid; if everyone is trapped, the battle is lost.
Pyramid again every 3 turns, plus 1 turn for each member KO'd or trapped.
Electro-mag Rod (1 in 3, can paralyze) or Short Staff on a random member.
After a Bolt spell hits him
His next turn: Electro-mag Rod on the caster.
Frees everyone in a Pyramid and retreats (“It's time.”).

ai_summary.title: With Rude (Lv 22)
rows: Short Staff or Turk Light (half each) on a random member.
After a Bolt spell hits him
His next turn: Electroprod on the caster.
Retreats (“We may be retreating, but… we're still victorious.”).

ai_summary.title: Lv 42 fight
rows: Short Staff or Neo Turk Light (Confusion), half each, on a random member.
After a Bolt spell hits him
His next turn: Electroprod 2 on the caster.

ai_summary.title: With Rude and Elena (Lv 50)
rows: Short Staff; then Electroprod or Short Staff; then Turk Light; repeats. Always on a random member.
All three Turks retreat (“Let's call it a day.”) and the battle ends.

ai_summary.title: Pyramid
rows: Nothing: it only holds the trapped member.

name: Sample:h0512
notes: Revives its Opt minions with Reanimagic, so ignore them and focus on H0512; they vanish when it dies. Shady Breath poisons the party and Keyclaw targets poisoned members, so cure Poison and heal everyone at once with All plus Restore.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Shady Breath (Poison) on the whole party.
Reanimagic revives the KO'd Opts while it has the MP (40 per cast).
Keyclaw on a random poisoned member; 1 in 4 Shady Breath again while someone is not poisoned.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: On a random member: Bodyblow 1 in 4; Rolling Attack 1 in 4 (not while H0512 is paralyzed); Fire 1 in 12; Ice 1 in 12. Otherwise nothing.

name: Hundred Gunner
notes: Only Barret's attacks, Limits and magic reach it; use Bolt. Below two thirds HP it switches to Main Artillery on the whole party, and below one third it charges for two turns before Wave Artillery, its strongest attack. Heli Gunner follows straight after, so heal before finishing it.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Aux Artillery on a random member; after the first turn, Hidden Artillery 1 in 4.
Main Artillery on the whole party.
Charges for two turns (“Sensor Cannon Charging!”, “Sensor Cannon Charged!”), then Wave Artillery on the whole party; repeats.

ai_summary.title: Position
rows: It stands far away: only long-range attacks, magic and Limits hit it.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: AB Cannon (Sleep) on a random member right away.
AB Cannon (Sleep) and C Cannon (Poison) in turn on random members; 1 in 4 turns Firing Line (Sleep, Poison) on the whole party instead.
Starts spinning: Defense and Magic Defense +50, and from then on Spinning Bodyblow or Flying Drill (half each) on a random member.

name: Rufus
notes: Cloud fights alone. Dark Nation casts Barrier on Rufus, halving physical damage to him, so defeat it first or use magic on Rufus. Keep Cloud healed with Cure or Potions.

Retreats (“Heh… That's all for today…”), taking Dark Nation with him.

notes: Casts Barrier on Rufus, then Barrier and MBarrier on itself. Defeat it first; magic ignores its back-row position.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Barrier on Rufus (Bite instead when out of MP).
Barrier, then MBarrier on itself, 1 in 2 turns each until both are up; other turns Bite or Bolt on Cloud.

name: Motor Ball
notes: Repeats a fixed cycle: two turns of Arm Attack on the highest-HP member (sometimes twice in one turn), then Twin Burner, Deadly Wheel and Rolling Fire on the whole party. The first time it falls below 1/8 HP it skips ahead to Twin Burner. Use Bolt, link Elemental with Fire in armor, and keep party-wide healing ready.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (7-turn cycle)
rows: Arm Attack on the member with the most HP, half the time twice.
Twin Burner on the whole party (Deadly Wheel when out of MP).
Deadly Wheel on the whole party.
Rolling Fire on the whole party (Deadly Wheel when out of MP); the cycle starts over.

The first time: Blown Away on the attacker.
The first time: Beta on the whole party, the only time it uses Beta.

Big Wave on the whole party, and every trapped member is freed.

Gas on a member under Stop if there is one, otherwise Stop on a member who isn't stopped.

Gas on a stopped member if there is one, otherwise 1 in 3 Gas on a random member. The cycle starts over.

Needle Gun and Molotov Cocktail every turn.

Hell Spear (Paralysis) half the time if that member is at half HP or less, otherwise Skewer.

Fire2 on its host for 4 turns, then returns; it returns at once if the host is KO'd.

notes: Undead: Cure, Potions and other healing damage it. Two Soul Fires possess party members and cast Fire2 on their host for four turns. Defeating Gi Nattak first destroys any remaining Soul Fires, so focus him and avoid Fire.

On a random member: DeBarrier 1 in 3 if they have Barrier or MBarrier; otherwise Drain 3 in 5, Aspil and then Spear Attack 1 in 5, Spear Attack 1 in 5.
Both Soul Fires vanish with him.

Only while upright: avoid hitting it physically.

Suicide Yang on a random member, and it is gone.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: “Yang's excited”: its Magic Attack rises by 10.

name: Lost Number
notes: Starts half physical, half magic. Below half HP it becomes the form that matches the hit that got it there: magic leaves the red magic form, which resists magic and casts spells, and physical leaves the purple physical form, which resists physical attacks and hits one member for 2000 or more with Lost Blow. Finish the first half with magic, then use physical attacks and Limits.

ai_summary.title: First form
rows: Punch on a random member, or 1 in 3 Bolt2 on one without Reflect; the chance of a second action the same turn rises as its HP drops.
The hit that brings it there decides its new form: a physical hit leaves the purple physical form, a spell the red magic form.

ai_summary.title: Magic form (red)
rows: On members without Reflect: Bio2 (preferring unpoisoned members), Bolt2 or Quake2, 2 in 7 each; Tentacle 1 in 7. Out of MP: Aspil on the member with the most MP.

ai_summary.title: Physical form (purple)
rows: Lost Blow 1 in 4 on a random member; otherwise Punch, half the time twice.

name: Materia Keeper
notes: Trine hits the whole party (learn it with Enemy Skill), Hell Combo hits one member hard, and it heals itself with Cure2. Its special attacks come more often as its HP drops, so set Big Guard and keep All plus Restore ready.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: 1 in 5 its first action is Trine.
Keyclaw or Big Horn on a random member; Hell Combo instead 1 in 5, rising as its HP drops (1 in 4 below 3/4, 1 in 3 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4).
Every fourth turn Cure2 on itself, and Trine on the whole party on the turn after (Hell Combo when out of MP).
After the first turn, Trine follows only a Cure2: bring it below half HP and wait.

name: Palmer
notes: Mostly harmless. Mako Gun casts Fire2, Ice2 or Bolt2 on a random member, and he can inflict Sadness. Attack with your strongest moves to finish quickly.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: 1 in 4 each: “Mako Gun” Fire2, Ice2 or Bolt2 on a random member, or Incite (“Heh-hic-heh-hic!”) on a member without Sadness.
Does nothing when the chosen spell needs more MP than he has, or everyone already has Sadness.

name: Rapps
notes: Cloud's party fights without Materia, since Yuffie took it and Corneo has kidnapped her. Aero3 can deal over 1300 damage to one member, so keep everyone's HP high; Barret's Mindblow drains his MP to stop it. Scorpion's Tail can poison and is often used twice in one turn.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (4-turn cycle)
rows: Starts at a random point of the cycle.
Wing Cut on a random member.
Scorpion's Tail (Poison) on a random member.
Aero3 on a random member while he has 50 MP; nothing otherwise.
Wing Cut and Scorpion's Tail come twice in one turn 1 in 9, rising as his HP drops (1 in 7 below 3/4, 1 in 5 below 1/2, 1 in 3 below 1/4).

name: Gorkii
notes: Yuffie fights alone. His spells hit hard early but he runs out of power, so set Big Guard and outlast him.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (3-turn cycle)
rows: Barrier, Regen or Reflect on himself: the first of them he lacks. With all three up, Demi2 instead.

name: Shake
notes: Yuffie fights alone. Mostly uses Beak. Below half HP he counters with Rage Bomber, which inflicts Fury (faster Limit gauge, but she misses more); he also uses it while poisoned, so don't poison him.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Beak or Rage Bomber (Fury), half each.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Every action against him: Rage Bomber (Fury) on the attacker.

name: Chekhov
notes: Yuffie fights alone. Opens with Stare Down, which paralyzes, and counters any magic with it again, so equip a Jem Ring. Below half HP he drains her with Absorb.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Absorb, on a paralyzed member if there is one.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Stare Down (Paralysis) on the caster: a Jem Ring prevents it.

name: Staniv
notes: Yuffie fights alone. Alternates Ironball with War Cry (Sadness) and may counter with Iron Attack when nearly dead. Counter Attack materia speeds the fight up.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Ironball on a paralyzed member, else one with Sadness, else the member with the most HP.
If no one has Sadness, 1 in 3 a War Cry (Sadness) turn follows; then the cycle restarts.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Half the time Iron Attack on the whole party.

name: Godo
notes: Yuffie fights alone. Uses gravity attacks that take a share of her HP, Trine, and Mini (Remedy or Cornucopia cures it). Late in the fight he heals with Cure2, but poison damage does not trigger it, so Bio works well. Learn Trine with Enemy Skill.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of his move chain.

Beast Sword on the whole party; Sleepel (Sleep) or Mini on the whole party; Drain on the member with the most HP; Bio2, Trine or Demi3 on the whole party. He picks the next move at random, changing form first when needed: human for Sleepel and Mini, beast for Beast Sword and Trine, the third form for Drain, Bio2 and Demi3.
Beast Sword when the chosen spell isn't possible: not enough MP, Reflect, or everyone already asleep or small.
Follows Bio2 or Trine 1 in 5, rising as his HP drops (1 in 4 below 4/5, 1 in 3 below 3/5, 1 in 2 below 2/5).

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: After every action against him, while he has MP and no Reflect: returns to human form and casts Cure2 on himself; 1 in 2 on the attacker instead when they are below 1/5 HP. Poison damage is not an action, so it never triggers this.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Frog Jab (toggles Frog) on a random member.
Frog Song (Sleep, Frog) on a member who isn't a frog, with idle turns before (0 to 3) and between (0 to 2). With everyone a frog: Frog Jab instead.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: 1 in 3: Frog Jab on the attacker.
1 in 3: Frog Song on the caster, an easy way to learn it.

name: Demons Gate
notes: Hits very hard: Cave-in and Demon Rush hit the whole party, and Petrif-Eye inflicts gradual Petrify. Its special attacks come more often as its HP drops. Use Big Guard and Regen, keep Soft or Ribbons ready, and let the damage build Limit Breaks.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Falling Rocks on a random member (a second one 1 in 8), then Cave-in on the party, then Petrif-Eye (gradual Petrify, 1 in 8) or Falling Rocks; repeats from a random step. It ignores members who are petrified or petrifying.
The second Falling Rocks and Petrif-Eye come more often: 1 in 4 below 3/4 HP, 1 in 3 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4.
Each first time: Advance on its next turn, then Demon Rush on the whole party one or two turns later, and it moves back.

name: Red Dragon
notes: Usually opens with Red Dragon Breath; it and Dragon Fang each hit one member hard. Set Big Guard, heal often, and use Ice or physical attacks.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Red Dragon Breath 3 in 4, Dragon Fang 1 in 4, on a random member.
Dragon Fang 1 in 2, Red Dragon Breath 1 in 4, Tail Attack 1 in 4, on a random member.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Bodyblow on the member with the least HP; every sixth turn Dark Needle (Darkness) on the member with the lowest Defense.
Ice2 on the member with the lowest Magic Defense (Dark Needle without MP), until a physical hit.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Killed by magic or a summon
Death Sentence on the killer: kill it with a spell to learn it.

name: Jenovalife
notes: Counters magic by casting Reflect on itself while it has MP, so lean on physical attacks and Limit Breaks. Aqualung hits the whole party; bring Enemy Skill to learn it. Its extra and special attacks get more frequent at 75%, 50% and 25% HP.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of the cycle.
Blue Light on a random member, a second one 1 in 5 (rising as its HP drops: 1 in 4 below 3/4, 1 in 3 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4).
Blue Flame on a random member. With the same rising chance, Aqualung on the whole party follows; otherwise the cycle restarts.
It comes more often as its HP drops.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Reflect on itself while it has none and has the MP.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: 1 in 4 it opens with Bad Breath.
Frozen Beam on a random member.
After a Frozen Beam, 1 in 8 (1 in 6 below 3/4 HP, 1 in 3 below 1/2) the next turn is Bio2 or Bad Breath on the whole party.
At most three times per battle.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (4-turn cycle)
rows: Starts at a random point of the cycle.
Jump Attack on the member with the most HP; Big Horn or Big Red Clipper (in turn); Big Horn or Big Red Clipper (at random); Magic Breath on the whole party while it has 75 MP (Jump Attack otherwise).
Its AI never uses it: learn it through Manipulate.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of its cycle.
Dragon Force on itself 1 in 5 (rising as its HP drops), followed by Blue Dragon Breath or Great Gale; otherwise Dragon Fang or Tail Attack.
Dragon Fang and Tail Attack turns, sometimes twice in one turn; Blue Dragon Breath on the member with the most HP, or Great Gale (Darkness) on the whole party, now and then.
The first time: its next turn is Blue Dragon Breath (at 3/4) or Great Gale (at 1/2 and 1/4).
Cast only on itself, and not in its Manipulate list: you cannot learn it here (Dark Dragon, through Manipulate).

steals.note: Deals 1500 fixed damage to all enemies.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Bodyblow on a random member half the time, otherwise nothing.
It grows: Bodyblow 1 in 2, Gush 1 in 4, nothing 1 in 4.
It grows again: Bodyblow, or half the time Bomb Blast on a random member, and it is gone.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: A hit that leaves it below 1/4 HP
Bomb Blast on a random member, and it is gone.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of its cycle.
Sham Seal, Sham Seal, then Aero3 (while it has 50 MP); repeats.
After a hit below half HP
Its next turn: White Wind on its own side (healing and curing them) while it is hurt and has 34 MP.
Cast only on its own side, and not in its Manipulate list: you cannot learn it here (Zemzelett, through Manipulate).

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Walks closer (Move) each turn, sometimes stepping left or right.
Half the time Knife (instant death) on the member in front of it; then it starts walking again.

name: Schizo(right)
notes: Two heads act separately and absorb different elements, so all-target Fire or Ice heals one of them. Every few hits each head counters with Tremor on the party. Each head breathes on the whole party as it dies, so heal before finishing either head.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (6-turn cycle)
rows: Right Breath (Fire) on a random member.
Double Breath (Fire, Ice) on a random member. Once the left head is down: Right Breath on each member instead.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Right Breath 2 (Lightning) on the whole party as it goes down. The battle ends when both heads are down.

name: Schizo(left)
notes: Two heads act separately and absorb different elements, so all-target Fire or Ice heals one of them. Every few hits each head counters with Tremor on the party. Each head breathes on the whole party as it dies, so heal before finishing either head.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (6-turn cycle)
rows: Left Breath (Ice) on a random member.
Double Breath (Fire, Ice) on a random member. Once the right head is down: Left Breath on each member instead.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Left Breath 2 (Lightning) on the whole party as it goes down. The battle ends when both heads are down.

name: Jenovadeath
notes: Silences one member early, so bring Echo Screens or a Ribbon. Tropic Wind hits the whole party, and its Red Light comes more often as its HP drops.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (6-turn cycle)
rows: Half the time it opens at turn 4.
Silence on a member who isn't silenced. If someone already is, or it lacks the MP: Red Light instead (as on turn 4).
Red Light: 1 in 4 on each member; otherwise three, two or one Red Lights on random members (1 in 4, 1 in 4, 2 in 4).
Tropic Wind on the whole party; the cycle starts over.
Red Light on each member gets likelier: 1 in 3 below 3/4 HP, 1 in 2 below 1/4.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: 100 Needles, then two turns of W Machine Gun (each half the time twice), on random members.
Its next turn answers the member who hit it: W Machine Gun; below 2/3 HP 100 Needles and W Machine Gun; below 1/3 HP Matra Magic, half the time twice.
It uses it only below 1/3 HP.

name: Carry Armor
notes: Lapis Laser hits the whole party hard and comes more often as its HP drops. Each arm can grab a member, who is out of action until that arm is destroyed or Carry Armor dies. Use all-target Bolt magic, Big Guard and Regen.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: 1 in 3 Lapis Laser on the whole party.
Lapis Laser on every member not held by an arm, 1 in 4; 1 in 3 below 3/4 HP, 1 in 2 below 1/2, every time below 1/4. The other turns nothing.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Damage Attack on each member an arm is holding.
Both arms let go of their members and vanish.

ai_summary.title: Carry Armor's arm
rows: If it holds no one: Arm Grab on a random free member (they are out of action until the arm or Carry Armor is destroyed), otherwise half the time Arm Punch. Holding someone: nothing.
1 in 16 at first; after it is hit, 1 in 128 above 3/4 HP, 1 in 32 below, 1 in 8 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4.
Damage Attack on the member it holds, and on the one the left arm holds.

ai_summary.title: Helletic Hojo's arm
rows: None: Helletic Hojo attacks with it.
Helletic Hojo switches to Sleepel and, half the time every other turn, revives this arm at full HP.

ai_summary.title: Carry Armor's arm
rows: If it holds no one: Arm Grab on a random free member (they are out of action until the arm or Carry Armor is destroyed), otherwise half the time Arm Punch. Holding someone: nothing.
1 in 16 at first; after it is hit, 1 in 128 above 3/4 HP, 1 in 32 below, 1 in 8 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4.
Damage Attack on the member it holds, and on the one the right arm holds.

ai_summary.title: Helletic Hojo's arm
rows: None: Helletic Hojo attacks with it.
Helletic Hojo switches to Pile Banger, often twice a turn, and Silence.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: It compares its own HP with the average HP of your living members, not with its maximum.
Viper Breath on the member with the most HP.
Huge Tidal Wave on the whole party every other turn.
Bring its HP down to 40-80% of your party's average HP.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (5-turn cycle)
rows: Starts at a random point of the cycle.
Big Punch on a random member.
Heavy Sword on a random member.
Atomic Ray on a random member 1 in 8 while it has 20 MP, otherwise Big Punch.
Big Guard on itself 1 in 8 while it has the MP and none of Barrier, MBarrier and Haste, otherwise Big Punch.
Atomic Ray and Big Guard get likelier: 1 in 4 below 3/4 HP, 1 in 3 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4.
Cast only on itself, and not in its Manipulate list: you cannot learn it here (Beachplug, through Manipulate).

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of its cycle.
Two turns of Claw, two of Behemoth Horn (each sometimes twice), then a special turn: ???? on a random member 1 in 8 while it has the MP, otherwise Claw and maybe Behemoth Horn.
Second attacks, early special turns and ???? come more often: 1 in 4 below 3/4 HP, 1 in 3 below 1/2.
Only on its special turn, so be patient or bring its HP down.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Flare on the caster while it has the MP.

name: Turks:elena
notes: Fought with Reno and Rude; the battle ends as soon as any one Turk falls. Each Turk resists or absorbs different elements, so check each card before using all-target elemental magic. Non-elemental attacks such as Ultima or Bahamut are safest.

ai_summary.title: With Reno and Rude
rows: Throw on the whole party (“Try this on for size!”).
Kick or Throw (half each) on a random member.

“Yeow! That hurts!”: she falls back. Then: a pause, Bewildered (Confusion) on a random member, four turns of Throw on the whole party, and a last Throw on the whole party as she returns (“Take THAT!!”).
Returns at once with Throw on the whole party.
All three Turks retreat (“Let's call it a day.”) and the battle ends.

name: Proud Clod
notes: While Jamar Armor stands, Proud Clod can use Materia Jammer to put Reflect on one member, and a Ribbon does not stop it, so destroy Jamar Armor first. Proud Clod fires machine guns and beams, and once damaged enough adds Beam Cannon on the whole party. Big Guard and Regen keep the fight safe.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of its chain.
W Machine Gun; then Big Hand Clash or Wrist Laser; then Knee Fire or Knee Blend; then a Materia-jammer turn; repeats. Always on random members.
Each attack comes twice in one turn 1 in 5, rising as its HP drops: 1 in 4 below 4/5, 1 in 3 below 3/5, 1 in 2 below 2/5, every time below 1/5.

While Jamar Armor stands and no member has Reflect: Materia-jammer (Reflect) on a member with that same chance, otherwise Big Hand Clash. With Jamar Armor down, or once someone has Reflect: W Machine Gun.
After each Materia-jammer turn it transforms, charges for a turn, fires Beam Cannon on the whole party, and changes back.

name: Jamar Armor
notes: Proud Clod's support unit; it has no attacks of its own. While it stands, Proud Clod can use Materia Jammer to put Reflect on a member, so defeat it first, then focus Proud Clod.

ai_summary.title: Proud Clod's support
rows: Nothing: it has no AI script and never uses Bodyblow.

name: Hojo
notes: Summons Poodler Sample and Bad Rap Sample and brings them back when they fall, so ignore them and attack Hojo directly; defeating him ends this stage.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: His samples start the battle KO'd.
Capsule brings every KO'd sample back at full HP and MP while he has the MP. He never attacks himself.
“Haw…now let's see how the Mako Juice is reacting?”: he transforms into Helletic Hojo and the samples leave.

name: Helletic Hojo
notes: Its right arm hits hard and revives almost immediately, so focus the main body. The fight inflicts Confusion, Sleep and Silence; Ribbons make it much easier.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Pile Banger on a member who is neither confused nor asleep, 1 in 3 twice, for three turns; then Confu (2 in 3) or Bio Gas (Poison) on a member who isn't confused. Starts at a random point.
Sleepel on a member who isn't asleep, confused or reflecting, then half the time Right Arm Revive (the right arm comes back at full HP); repeats.
Pile Banger, half the time twice, for two turns; then Silence on a member without Silence or Reflect.

name: Lifeform-hojo N
notes: Relies on status attacks rather than damage. With Ribbons equipped it is barely a threat, so hit it with your strongest attacks.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Four Combo hits on one member (one plain; the others inflict Poison, Darkness and Sleep), preferring a member with Slow; it switches targets when that member is KO'd.
Combo again 1 in 5; Slow on the whole party 2 in 5 (while someone isn't slowed); Absorb 2 in 5 on the member with the most HP while it is hurt, or the most MP while its MP isn't full.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Each first time: its next turn is a Combo on the member who hit it.
Silence on the caster while they aren't silenced and it has the MP.

ai_summary.title: Petrified
rows: Immune to physical attacks and magic. After two turns it comes alive.
It crumbles and is gone, with its living form.
Rock Finger (gradual Petrify) on the attacker, and it comes alive. The Attack command alone does not wake it.

ai_summary.title: Alive
rows: Kick on a member who isn't petrified, half the time twice.
Half the time L4 Death on every member who isn't petrified.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of its cycle.

Tail Attack, Claw, then Dragon Force on itself 1 in 5 (Claw otherwise), then Dark Dragon Breath (Darkness) on the whole party 1 in 5 (Tail Attack otherwise); repeats from a random step. Attacks come twice in one turn with the same chance.
That chance rises: 1 in 4 below 3/4 HP, 1 in 3 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4.
Its AI never uses it: learn it through Manipulate.
Cast only on itself: learn it through Manipulate.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Once per battle, with the same chance: Ultima on the whole party.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Walks closer (Move) each turn, sometimes stepping left or right.
Half the time Knife (instant death) on the member in front of it; then it starts walking again.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Para Tail (Sadness) on a member without Sadness; once everyone has it, Head Attack.
Its AI never uses them: learn them through Manipulate.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Magic Extinguish (Silence) on the caster, unless they are already silenced.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Cold Breath on a member who isn't confused.
It casts it only on itself: learn it through Manipulate.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Fascination (Confusion) on the attacker, unless they are confused.
The first time each, instead: Fire3 on the attacker; Angel Whisper on itself; Angel Whisper on itself and Fire3 on the attacker.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of its cycle.
Spin Turn for two turns (each sometimes twice), Emperor on itself below half HP (Spin Turn otherwise), then Star. It avoids stopped members.

Above 3/4 HP the cycle restarts. Below 3/4: Sun (Darkness or Silence) on a member without it. Below 1/2: Sun, or World (Stop) on a member, a turn of waiting, then Hidden One (Death) on a stopped member. Below 1/4: always World and Hidden One.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Roulette on the attacker: the only time it uses Roulette.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Starts at a random point of its cycle.

Poison Fang on a member without Poison (sometimes twice); Body Tail on the whole party, or Bone (Paralysis) on a member who isn't paralyzed; Abnormal Breath (Poison) on the party or Poison Fang; then Shadow Flare, preferring a paralyzed member, or Body Tail. Repeats from a random step.
Bone, Abnormal Breath, Shadow Flare and the second Poison Fang come 1 in 5, rising as its HP drops (1 in 4 below 3/4, 1 in 3 below 1/2, 1 in 2 below 1/4).

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Pandora's Box on the whole party, but only once in the whole game: the first Dragon Zombie you defeat uses it, later ones never do. Have Enemy Skill equipped that time.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: “Gimme Elixir!” and nothing else. It is immune to physical attacks and magic.
It stops asking and can be damaged.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Any other action, before the Elixir
1 in 4 Gimme on the attacker; otherwise, 1 in 16 it runs away.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (7-turn cycle)
rows: Starts at a random point of the cycle.
Flutilizer on a random member, preferring frogs, sometimes twice.
Frog Song (Sleep, Frog) on a member who isn't a frog, 1 in 5 (rising as its HP drops; Aspil on the member with the most MP when out of MP); otherwise Flutilizer.
Below half HP: Cure2 on its side's members at 2/3 HP or less (Aspil without MP); otherwise Flutilizer.
High/Low Suit twice on a member with Fury (Aspil if nobody has Fury); Suffocation Song (Death) on a member with Sadness (Bolt3 if nobody does); then Stardust March.
Only on turn 3, 1 in 5, rising to 1 in 2 below 1/4 HP.

name: Jenovasynthesis
notes: Below 15,000 HP it starts a countdown and then casts Ultima, which ends the fight with no EXP or AP, so defeat it before the count runs out. Repeating Slap can inflict Fury and Absorb Sadness; it also casts Bio2 (Poison) and Stop.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (5-turn cycle)
rows: Repeating Slap (Fury) on a random member while its left hand stands.
Absorb (Sadness) on a random member while its right hand stands.
Both hands up: Bio2 on the whole party. Only the left hand: Stop on a random member. Only the right hand: Cure3 on its side. Both hands down: revives them at 1/4 HP and raises its defenses again.

ai_summary.title: Hands and countdown
rows: Jenova's Defense (left hand) or Magic Defense (right hand) drops, and the turns that hand would act are lost.
Counts down 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 over five turns, then Ultima on the whole party ends the battle. Defeat it before the count runs out.
Your party's levels and the number of turns this fight took set up the Bizarro·Sephiroth battle that follows.

name: Bizarrosephiroth
notes: Its Core restores a large share of the main body's HP almost every turn, so put your heaviest damage on the main body, or defeat the Core if the healing outpaces you.

ai_summary.title: Parts
rows: Defeating it ends the battle; every part vanishes with it.
Revived by the body 1 to 3 turns after it falls.
Immune to physical attacks and magic until both magic parts (D, E) are down. Each turn: Bizzarro Enegy, a large heal on the body.
Right Magic (D) absorbs Ice and Lightning and lets the body cast Bolt3 and Ice3; Left Magic (E) absorbs Fire and Earth and lets it cast Quake3 and Fire3.

ai_summary.title: Body, each turn (8-turn cycle)
rows: If D and E have both been down for more than 8 turns: revives them and the core closes up again. Otherwise, with the head down: Aurora Fence removes every status from everyone.
Bolt3 (needs D), then Quake3 (needs E), on a random member.
Stigma (Poison, Slow) on the whole party while the core and head stand; with the core down: Heartless Angel.
Ice3 (needs D), then Fire3 (needs E), on a random member.
Sephiroth Shock on a random member whenever the turn's move is not possible.

ai_summary.title: Battle setups
rows: The parts' HP grows with the number of party members at level 99.
Its other records are the battles fought by several parties in turn: their HP differs, and the parts destroyed carry over from one party's battle to the next.

name: Safersephiroth
notes: Equip Ribbons: Pale Horse, Break and his wing attack inflict statuses, and DeSpell strips your buffs. Super Nova hits the whole party. Use Big Guard, Regen, and your strongest summons and Limits; Shadow Flare can be learned here.

ai_summary.title: Each turn (8-turn cycle)
rows: Wall (Barrier, MBarrier) on himself, or, every other cycle, DeSpell on the whole party; DeSpell on himself when he is slowed.
After Wall: Shadow Flare on a random member. After DeSpell: Deen on the whole party.
An unnamed attack on the member with the most HP.
Rises out of reach of short-range attacks.
Pale Horse (Sadness, Frog, Small) on a random member.
Super Nova (Confusion, Silence, Slow) on the whole party.
Break (Petrify) on a random member; below 1/4 HP Heartless Angel instead.
Comes back down; the cycle starts over.

ai_summary.title: Other
rows: Grow with the number of party members at level 99.
It comes on turn 2 of the cycles that start with Wall.

name: Sephiroth
notes: Final one-on-one with Cloud, who starts with a full Limit gauge. Any attack wins.

ai_summary.title: Final duel
rows: Cut on Cloud, then Cloud strikes back by himself.

name: Diamond Weapon
notes: Immune to physical attacks at first. When it starts counting down to Diamond Flash it opens up to physical hits, so switch to attacks and Limits then. Diamond Flash hits the whole party and can Silence, so set Big Guard and heal before the count runs out.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Diamond Fire on a random member, followed 2 in 3 by Foot Stamp on the member with the most HP; after Foot Stamp, 3 in 4 back to Diamond Fire.
“Countdown”, “3”, “2”, “1”: Diamond Fire each turn, then at “0” Diamond Flash (Silence) on the whole party, and it closes up again.

ai_summary.title: Defenses
rows: No effect, except during the countdown.
They hit it, and the second one (the third below half HP) starts the countdown.

name: Ruby Weapon
notes: Cannot be damaged until it plants its tentacles in the sand. Whirlsand removes a member from the battle for good but cannot target the last active character, so start with two members KO'd and revive them once the tentacles are down. Not immune to Paralysis: Dazers stop its attacks.

ai_summary.title: Before the tentacles
rows: Immune to physical attacks and magic until it plants its tentacles for the first time.
With more than one member standing: Big Claw, Whirlsand and Big Swing (Paralysis) in turn. With only one member standing it plants its tentacles at once.
Big Claw, Big Swing or Comet2 at random.
1 in 5 it plants its tentacles, otherwise Big Swing, Big Claw or Comet2.
Any action against it: Whirlsand on a random member while more than one member stands. Whirlsand removes them from the battle.

ai_summary.title: Tentacles planted
rows: It can be damaged from now on, even after pulling the tentacles back.

Ruby Flame, Ruby Ray (Confusion), Left or Right Revenge; from turn 11 also Shadow Flare, Ultima and the Thrusts. Whirlsand returns from turn 26 while more than two members stand, from turn 33 while more than one stands.
Any action against it: Right Thrust (Frog, Small) or Left Thrust (Poison, gradual Petrify) on a random member.
Only with its tentacles planted, from turn 11.

name: Ruby's Tentacle
notes: Ruby Weapon cannot be damaged until these are planted in the sand. Focus the main body rather than the tentacles.

name: Emerald Weapon
notes: Without Underwater materia the fight has a 20-minute timer. Aire Tam Storm deals 1111 damage per equipped materia to each character, so keep everyone at 8 or fewer. Emerald Beam hits the whole party and removes Regen.

ai_summary.title: Each turn
rows: Emerald Shoot on a random member (removes Barrier, MBarrier, Shield), Foot Stamp on the whole party, Emerald Shoot again; the first two may repeat. Below half HP it skips the Foot Stamps.
Opens up: its four Eyes return at full HP, and Emerald Beam (removes Regen) hits the whole party.
Emerald Beam and Aire Tam Storm on the whole party in turn, until all four Eyes are destroyed; then it closes and starts over.

ai_summary.title: Counter
rows: Every action against it except a Limit: Revenge Stamp (removes Haste) on the whole party.

name: Eye
notes: Emerald Weapon's eyes: blue eyes fire damaging lasers and orange eyes drain MP. The fight is won by defeating Emerald Weapon itself.

ai_summary.title: Emerald Weapon's eye
rows: Emerald Laser on a random member.
Emerald Weapon closes up and stops using Aire Tam Storm until it opens again.
